lines.text: Ben loved October hikes in his dark green jacket.
Then he heard a shot echo across the valley.
Fall is hunting season in much of the US and Canada, and many hiking trails cross hunting land.
Check local season dates before you go,
wear bright blaze orange on your body and your pack,
and stay on the marked trail.
Now Ben is the brightest thing in the woods.
Save this for your fall hikes.
